_meta.description: Per-asset-class settled spawn clearance above TABLE_Z (metres). clearance = settled body_xpos_z - TABLE_Z. Generated by scripts/measure_spawn_clearances.py from real LIBERO MuJoCo assets.

bowl_drainer.note: WS follow-up distractor-settle RCA: bowl_drainer (irregular flat-bottomed dish rack) was injected at the generic x90 'upright' fallback, which tips it onto a rim and slides ~6-9mm during the 50-step settle (pose_err 11.8mm). It is now injected at its stable IDENTITY (base-down) rest (asset_metadata._DISTRACTOR_TABLE_REST_QUAT). The identity rest is xy-INVARIANT: its converged (2000-step) body-origin clearance is 0.08599 above TABLE_Z at every measured table placement, with tip 0deg and dxy 0; injected exactly there the 50-step production settle is a no-op (dxy/dz/d3 = 0.00mm). The old 0.17579 was the x90 settle (and the intermediate 0.1701/0.135 trials were free-fall mid-points from injecting above the true rest). Reproduce: scripts/measure_spawn_clearances.py --distractor-table-only (with the identity rest active).
